name: Alternating MaxVol Column Sampling
aliases: Alternating Maximum Volume Approximation for Column Sampling
definition: An algorithm to select a subset of rows and columns from a large matrix (or tensor core) to form a low-rank approximation, using the maxvol algorithm to find a submatrix with a large determinant.
summary: Alternating MaxVol Column Sampling iteratively selects columns to maximize submatrix volume, guaranteeing a superior basis representation compared to random sampling.
